input: # comma-chain.tsv: a comma expression of 130 operands, as a declaration's
# initializer. Its tree holds the operands in one comma_expression, so it
# nests 18 levels however many there are. Through 0.6.1, C's transducer
# part held each operation of an expression inside the one that took it
# until the expression ended, two levels an operand here, so from 124
# operands its scan-emit state nested past transduce's max_depth (256),
# which the tree, read whole, is far below (tabnas/c#80). From 0.6.2 a
# finished operation is C's node in a register of its own, and the state
# nests no deeper for more operands.
